purpose: Separate learned edit magnitude from direction on all six existing development queries, using a deterministic norm/orientation exchange with no new fitting.
scope: Exploratory explanation after observing R20 outcomes and after the R21 primary procedure was frozen. Only the retained R20 original dev rows are evaluated. Four variants use geometric or output-fitted orientation crossed with geometric or output-fitted norm. Positive rescaling preserves nonnegative target writes and the same 256-member cap. It does not enter or change the frozen confirmation candidate set, selection policies or parameters, and is not independent confirmation. No scalar fit or held-data tuning.

variants.geometric_learned_norm: geometric direction rescaled to the norm of the fitted direction for each sign
variants.functional_original_norm: fitted direction rescaled to the original geometric norm for each sign
